title: Candlestick chart
description: Open, high, low and close prices per period, for stocks, crypto or any OHLC data. Rising and falling candles get their own colors, line series can be added (moving averages) and long histories stay smooth to zoom and pan on the GPU.

examples.title: Moving averages
examples.description: Series with type: "line" are drawn over the candles, here 5 and 20-day moving averages that start with null values. Hover a day to read its OHLC values, its change and both averages.

translationResources.title: Candlestick chart
translationResources.description: Open, high, low and close prices per period, for stocks, crypto or any OHLC data. Rising and falling candles get their own colors, line series can be added (moving averages) and long histories stay smooth to zoom and pan on the GPU.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Points carry open, high, low and y (the close). Candles are green when they close up and red when they close down; upColor / downColor swap them for markets that use the opposite convention. renderTooltip writes the OHLC values with Intl.NumberFormat in the reader's language.

moving-average.title: Moving averages
moving-average.description: Series with type: "line" are drawn over the candles, here 5 and 20-day moving averages that start with null values. Hover a day to read its OHLC values, its change and both averages.

large-data.title: 50,000 candles
large-data.description: One-minute candles as typed-array columns { x, open, high, low, y } on a time axis. Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel to zoom until single candles appear, drag to pan, double-click to reset.

volume.title: Prices and volume
volume.description: A CandlestickChart over a BarChart of the volumes, each bar colored like its candle. onZoom of one chart calls setView on the other so both stay aligned when you zoom or pan, and the layout event pads the axis with the narrower labels so the candles sit right above their bars.

intraday.title: Intraday session
intraday.description: 5-minute candles of one session with the VWAP as a line series and an x line marking a news release; the time axis shows the exchange's local time with Intl.DateTimeFormat and timeZone.

bar-styles.title: OHLC bars, candles and hollow candles
bar-styles.description: The same 70 days three ways with TradingChart's chartStyle: OHLC bars (open tick on the left, close on the right), candles, and hollow candles, whose body is empty when the close is above the open and whose color follows the previous close.

ma-ribbon.title: Moving average ribbon
ma-ribbon.description: Eight exponential averages from 10 to 80 bars, warm to cool: the ribbon fans out in a trend and twists when it turns. Each average has its color and width; the legend lists their values at the crosshair.

volume-colors.title: Volume colored by candle
volume-colors.description: Volume bars take the color of their candle, with a 20-bar average: in their own pane, or at the bottom of the price pane with overlay.

a-share.title: Chinese market convention
a-share.description: colorConvention="redUp" draws rising candles in red and falling ones in green, as in mainland China, with the usual MA 5 / 10 / 20 / 60, volume and MACD. The legend speaks the page language (开 高 低 收 in Chinese).

events.title: Event markers
events.description: markers pin corporate events to their day: earnings, dividends and a split above the candles, a guidance cut below, each with its color and a short text.

live.title: Live candles
live.description: Five-second candles fed ten times a second through update on the ref: the last candle grows, a new one starts every five seconds, and the countdown under the last price shows when it closes.

dark.title: Night theme
dark.description: The chart reads its colors from CSS variables: a container that sets them (background, text, up / down colors) restyles the candles, the axes, the legends and the crosshair, here with hollow candles and a watermark.

patterns.title: Candlestick patterns
patterns.description: A plain function scans the bars for dojis, hammers, shooting stars and engulfing candles; the matches become markers (bullish below the candle, bearish above), filtered by the radio group. onCrosshairMove names the pattern under the crosshair.

watchlist.title: Watchlist cards
watchlist.description: Small CandlestickCharts for crypto, a stock, a currency pair and gold: legend={false} and hidden axes leave only the candles, a dashed y annotation marks the opening price, and Intl formats each quote its own way (dollars, five-decimal rates, hours or dates). renderTooltip keeps the tooltip to one line.

fx-pips.title: FX pips and pivots
fx-pips.description: EUR/USD hourly candles in UTC: formatPrice shows five decimals, priceLines draws Thursday's floor pivots (P, R1, S1) for Friday, and onCrosshairMove measures the hovered candle in pips: its range, its body, its change from the previous close and the distance from the last price.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: 40 trading days of ACME: rising and falling candles in the success and danger colors; onHover writes the open and close of the touched day below the chart.

CandlestickChartProps.series: Series drawn as candles unless they set a type (e.g. a moving average line); points carry open, high, low and y (the close)

ohlc.title: Daily candles
ohlc.description: Each point carries open, high, low and close; rising and falling candles take the success and danger colors.

moving-average.title: Moving average overlay
moving-average.description: A series of type line drawn over the candles: the 5-day moving average of the closes.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
